beats.text: You can now feed 500,000 tokens to Grok for two dollars, and it just tied OpenAI's best model.
beats.show_cue: The xAI API playground showing a massive 500k context prompt loading.

beats.text: xAI shipped Grok 4.6 as a post-training upgrade. They expanded the context window to 500,000 tokens while freezing API pricing at two dollars per million input tokens.
beats.show_cue: The official Grok 4.6 pricing card held on the $2/$6 rates.

beats.text: On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Grok 4.6 scored 61, tying GPT-5.6 Sol Max for top rank. That is frontier intelligence at a budget price.
beats.show_cue: The Artificial Analysis leaderboard showing Grok 4.6 tied with Sol Max.
curiosity_queries: frontier LLM price to performance index

beats.text: The catch. This is a fine-tune polish, not a new brain. At 500K tokens, needle in a haystack retrieval still drops when you ask it to reason across ten documents at once.
beats.show_cue: A multi-document context retrieval accuracy graph showing degradation at 500K.

beats.text: For heavy document search it is a bargain, but verify your complex queries before firing your old pipeline.
beats.show_cue: Operator on camera, terminal window in corner inset.

beats.text: How is AI touching your life right now? Tell us.
